study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized cortical thickness asymmetry in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used data from 20 scan sites. Identified datasets include: ABIDE-I (NYU, USM sites), ABIDE-II (GU, OHSU sites), COBRE, Utrecht, Cam-CAN (CAMCAN), IXI, NKI (ROCKLAND), OASIS. Additional sites without standard dataset names include: MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD, BGS, AOMIC-ID1000, AOMIC-PIOP1, AOMIC-PIOP2, DLBS, NARRATIVES, SALD - these are classified under MULTI-SITE.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We examined data for 5430 healthy individuals (44.68% male) and 422 cases, taken from 20 different scan sites." ... Supplemental Table 2 lists sites: "ABIDE-I NYU, ABIDE-I USM, ABIDE-II GU, ABIDE-II OHSU, MITASD, WASHASD, MADRID-ASD, BGS, COBRE, UTRECHT, AOMIC-ID1000, AOMIC-PIOP1, AOMIC-PIOP2, CAMCAN, DLBS, IXI, NARRATIVES, SALD, OASIS, ROCKLAND"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: For datasets with healthy controls only, 90% went into training and 10% into test (HCtest). For clinical datasets (those including cases and healthy controls), 90% of healthy controls were added to training, 10% to HCtest, and all ASD/SZ cases were added to the test set. This constitutes a within-site-split design.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "For each of the datasets exclusively comprising healthy controls 90% of individuals went into the training set and 10% into the test set (HCtest) ... From each of the clinical datasets, i.e. those datasets including cases and healthy controls, 90% of the healthy controls were added to the training set and 10% were added to the HCtest. All cases with ASD or SZ were added to the test set. Both the training and test sets comprised individuals from the same scanners, constituting a 'within-site-split'."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Single normative model was built using Bayesian Linear Regression. Overall healthy individuals: 5430 (before train/test split). Training set: 4904 healthy individuals. Test set (HCtest): 526 healthy controls (derived from 5430 - 4904 = 526).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Overall: 5430 healthy individuals with 44.68% male = 2426 males (calculated: 5430 * 0.4468 = 2426), 55.32% female = 3004 females. Training: 4904 with 54.85% female = 2690 females (4904 * 0.5485 = 2690), 45.15% male = 2214 males. Test set (HCtest): 526 with 40% male = 210 males, 60% female = 316 females.
